_note: Added August 27, 2026. THE single home for Iván's coaching credentials and athletic record, in all three languages. Same pattern and same reason as library.json: before this file existed, the only credential anywhere on the site was '🏅 Coach certificado IRONMAN', hand-written three times into planes/triatlon/index.njk, and the only mention of the TrainingPeaks relationship as a credential was inside the copy-paste blurb on /referidos/. Rendered by partials/trust-bar.njk and by the three About pages. Add a credential here, it appears everywhere — do not hand-write one into a page.
_wordingNote: The exact marks matter and are NOT interchangeable with how Iván describes them verbally. TrainingPeaks calls it 'Level 2 Accredited', never 'Level 2 Certified' (help.trainingpeaks.com/hc/en-us/articles/226260048). That same page is what licenses the badge for website use: 'You can also use these images on your website and/or emails.' Coach Match is described by TrainingPeaks itself as 'a limited directory of coaches' (help.trainingpeaks.com/hc/en-us/articles/360058864132) — that phrase is quotable because it is theirs. Credential names are proper marks and stay in English in all three languages; only the surrounding prose is translated.
_partnerNote: Decision, Iván, Aug 27, 2026: the word 'partner' MAY appear in body prose, and MUST NOT appear in any <title>, meta description, or JSON-LD field. The distinction is not cosmetic — prose is retractable, structured data is what Google and the LLMs ingest as an entity fact, and once ingested 'I can remove it' stops being true. 'Partner' is inferred from the CoachMatch relationship; every other claim in this file is a mark the issuer granted.
_ironmanU_SUNSET: IRONMAN U concluded when TriDot ended its IRONMAN sponsorship; the content and the coaching community moved to the Endurance Sports Coaching Institute (ESCI), which is live at esci.institute and issues the 'ESCI Certified Coach' mark. Iván holds BOTH today and states IRONMAN U disappears in 2027. It is therefore printed with its year — 'IRONMAN U Certified Coach · 2025' — which is accurate now and stays accurate after the programme is gone, rather than becoming a false present-tense claim on that date. When 2027 arrives, delete the ironmanu entry from the three `items` arrays and from the About pages' schema block. Nothing else needs touching.
_sameAsNote: JSON-LD only — deliberately NOT a visible link anywhere on the site. This is the whole 'borrow the authority, keep the transaction' decision expressed in one field: sameAs tells Google and the LLMs that this person and that TrainingPeaks profile are the same entity, which is exactly the authority signal we want, WITHOUT giving a coaching lead a clickable route into TrainingPeaks — where the same athlete routes through CoachMatch at 20% instead of Private at 3.5%. See pricing-and-positioning.md: the same athlete is worth $24.59/month more on Private.

_recordNote: Athletic and coaching record, stated by Ivan Aug 27, 2026. ONE figure here needs protecting from a well-meaning future correction: '+100 athletes coached' is NOT reproducible from data/athlete_tenure.csv, which holds 98 rows — and it is still correct. That file's earliest signup is 2024-05-01, while the business was founded roughly a year earlier, so the whole pre-May-2024 cohort is outside it. Do not 'fix' this to 98. If a figure is ever needed that the tenure file DOES own, it is 98 athletes since May 2024 (82 TP Coach Match, 16 Private).
_reviewCountNote: The review row's figure is the literal token {reviewCount}, substituted at render time from site.reviewCount. Deliberate: this is a live metric that moves, and a second typed copy is exactly how the homepage ended up showing 45 for thirteen days.
_strydNote: Resolved Aug 27, 2026, from Iván. The badge mark reads 'Certified Stryd Coach'; the course behind it is the 'Stryd Power Coaching Course'. Both are recorded — the mark is the credential name (what the badge says and what a reader recognises), the course is the note (what he actually completed). He is listed at stryd.com/coaches, but that page opens a sidebar with no per-coach URL, so there is NO Stryd entry in `sameAs`: sameAs must identify the person, and a shared directory page identifies every coach on it. A URL that resolves to the wrong entity is worse than no URL.
_badgeNote: Badge images added Aug 27, 2026, in site/assets/images/badges/. TrainingPeaks supplies its Level 2 Accredited badge in two variants — a white 'TRAININGPEAKS' wordmark and a black one. THE BLACK ONE IS THE CORRECT CHOICE HERE and the white one must not be substituted: every surface this renders on is white or Blue Wash, and the white wordmark would disappear entirely, leaving a shield with no attribution. Kept at its native 85px — the largest TrainingPeaks supplies — and displayed at 40px, so it is never upscaled. The Stryd badge was downscaled from a 600px original to 120px, 3x of the same 40px display height.
_stripNote: `short` is what the homepage/All-Access strip prints; `name` is the full mark and is what the About pages and the Person schema use. The strip renders NAMES ONLY — the `note` field is deliberately not rendered there. First version did render notes, and the result was a ~450px wall of explanatory copy directly under a photo hero: five long names, five sentences, in a ragged 3+2 grid where the badged rows were indented and the text-only ones were not, so nothing aligned. A trust strip is glanced at, not read. The explanation belongs on the About page, where there is room for it and where someone has chosen to read.
